extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 19 inch 42U server rack cabinet, 60 x 100 cm footprint, 200 cm high
extras.notes: front faces -Y; white rounded cabinet with top vents, dark plinth on levelling feet, dark framed glass door (light tinted alpha glass, not baked) with bar handle, plain lock knob and hinges on the left; inside dark mounting rails and mixed units (patch panel, switches, 1U/2U servers with drive bays, 4U storage, blanking panels, UPS) with white/light-grey fronts, pastel handles and small glowing LEDs (emissive, not baked). The door 'server-rack_door' (glass parented to it) has its origin on the hinge axis at the front left edge; rotate around local Z (-100 degrees opens it). No text, no logos.

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
